verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs explicitly state ODC instances are priced hourly but billed in one-minute increments, and billing only accrues while an instance is running/attached — corroborated by a community report where a user was billed for the full duration their instance remained running (idle counted as running, confirming billing follows instance lifecycle rather than usage activity). Missing for 10: true per-second billing granularity (only per-minute is documented), and independent/user confirmation that billing precisely matches the one-minute increment claim.
